agent_note: 38 quotes, both chunks complete. Third-person past narration with very heavy dialogue; quotation marks survive on most speech quotes, so mark-majority was the primary signal, with vocative/direct-address/register used only where marks were stripped. Event split 10 past / 1 present. The lone present quote (q10533) is a self-contained present-tense scene, not a strand visible elsewhere. Main residual risk: a cluster of first-person unmarked quotes (q10522, q10526, q10534, q10541, q10547, q10557) read as speech; q10540 has explicit letter framing and was read as event/past, and if that cluster is also epistolary the book gains a dual (recounting vs writing-moment) component.
